1967 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1967 is not).  
From 10 Sep 1967, subtract 257 days stepwise:  
Back 257 days = back 9 months (Jan–Aug 31 + Sep 10 = 253 days?) Let’s compute exactly:  

Count backward:  
Sep 10 → Aug 31: 10 days (257–10=247 left)  
August: 31 days (247–31=216)  
July: 31 days (216–31=185)  
June: 30 days (185–30=155)  
May: 31 days (155–31=124)  
April: 30 days (124–30=94)  
March: 31 days (94–31=63)  
February: 28 days (63–28=35)  
January: 31 days (35–31=4)  
Remaining 4 days back from Jan 1 → Dec 28, 1966.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1966-12-28
